# AutoAgile: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code edbc103e2cc3 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Kanban, sprints and roadmaps for crews of humans and AI developers. Complexity-gate estimates, an agent API, and levels that unlock as your crew matures.
**Live:** https://autoagile.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/autoagile · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `autoagile/.claude/skills/autoagile/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py autoagile` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms vs JavaScript (converted 2026-11-08, branch `forms`).** Every page, menu, list and dialog is a Form. The one
  engine is `theme/assets/aa-engine.js` (window.AA): the SVG charts (`AA.chart.*`, wrapped by `Components/Chart`), the
  d3 reports (`AA.report`, called by `Pages/Reports`; d3 loads on demand from `_/theme/d3.v7.9.0.min.js`), mini
  markdown (`Components/Md`), the Jira/Trello/CSV readers (`AA.imp`, kept in JS with the parsed file; `Pages/Import`
  keeps the mapping), board drag and drop (`AA.dnd`, calls `Board._drop`), the LEVEL UP rave, downloads and copy.
  `startup.py` points `AA.toast` / `AA.go` at the app's toasts and router. The engine was composed from the old
  web/pages files (_aa.html, reports.html, import.html); edit it directly now.
- **Crews:** `client_code/aa.py` keeps the crew list (`my_crews`) and the current crew (browser storage `autoagile.crew`,
  same key as before). Every crew page starts with `self.crew = aa.need_crew(self)`; with no crew it sets
  `self.redirected` and the router skips opening it. `#card/KEY` switches to the crew of the key's prefix.
- **Router specials:** `#backlog/party` opens `Pages/Party`, `#crew/new` + `#crew/join` open `Pages/CrewStart`,
  `#ask/<code>` is `Pages/Ask`. Pages with document listeners (Party's 1-4/Enter/S keys) stop them in `leave()`.
- **Gates:** `Components/Gates` (Items/GateRow + Items/Rung) scores with `aa.gate_score`, a copy of server_code/Gates.py;
  `aa.GATES_CFG` is the copy visitors use on the landing page. Change all three together.
- **Filter language** (board, backlog): `aa.matches` / `aa.parse_query` (was AA.match).
- **Nested lists** (year roadmap quarters > epic cards, request rows, past sprints, alert kinds) carry `host` (the page)
  in their item and call page methods; one-level lists raise `x-...` events on their panel.
- **Header:** `Layouts/Shell` draws the crew chip + Ctrl K button from `aa.current()`; Ctrl K or / opens
  `Dialogs/Palette`, `g` + a letter jumps (GO table in Shell). After switching crew, `router.refresh_shell()`.
- **CSS:** app.css was composed from the template core + the old core.css skin + every page's styles; the Forms
  additions are the last block ("AutoAgile as native Forms"). Labels inherit their font from their role
  (`.anvil-label > span { font: inherit }`), so old `.x span` rules no longer style Label text: give the Label a role.
- **Tests:** `tools/ui/smoke.js` (signed out, member in the demo crews, admin = arkulinskis@gmail.com signed up in the
  local database with a fixed local password). `python -I tools/ui_test.py` runs it; a11y.js/design.js on request.
- **Validator:** dialog arguments are popped from `**properties` (a `None` default is typed None for good);
  `aa.loose()` hands mixed dicts on untyped. Never re-annotate a parameter (`cfg: dict = cfg or X` is a NameError in Skulpt).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Client side

**Components/**
- `Components/Chart` (46/9): A chart drawn by the engine. draw(kind, opts, cols=None, rows=None): kind is bars|grouped…
- `Components/Gates` (87/35): The complexity-gates widget (was AA.gateWidget): four answers per gate, the points ladder…
- `Components/Md` (28/15): Mini markdown text (card descriptions). The HTML comes from the engine (AA.md), which esc…
- `Components/Who` (45/18): Avatar for a card's assignee, an event's author or a crew member (was AA.who).

**Dialogs/**
- `Dialogs/AgentDialog` (53/17): Add an AI developer (closes with the server reply incl. its token) or edit one (closes wi… · calls create_agent, delete_agent, update_agent
- `Dialogs/AnswerDialog` (39/10): Answer a request: accept (note optional), later or decline (a reason of 10+ characters).… · calls answer_request
- `Dialogs/CloseSprint` (24/13): Close the running sprint: where unfinished cards go. Closes with 'next' / 'backlog', or N…
- `Dialogs/CrewSwitcher` (32/12): Pick the crew to look at (the header chip). Closes with the crew id, or None.
- `Dialogs/EpicDialog` (61/20): New or edit an epic (name, what and why, size, quarter, status, colour). Closes with True… · calls delete_epic, save_epic
- `Dialogs/GateDialog` (34/10): Estimate one card through the gates (from a backlog row). Closes with the server's gate r… · calls estimate_card
- `Dialogs/Palette` (98/7): Ctrl K: jump to a page or a card, add a card by typing its title, switch crew. Arrow keys… · calls search_cards
- `Dialogs/RetroDialog` (39/15): The retro: LOUDER / MUTE / REMIX + action items. Closes with True when saved. · calls save_retro
- `Dialogs/TextDialog` (28/9): Ask for one line of text (the sprint goal). Closes with the text, or None.
- `Dialogs/TokenDialog` (29/14): An agent's new token, shown once, with the CLAUDE.md snippet.

## Biggest files (read these in parts)

`theme/assets/app.css` 1675, `theme/assets/aa-engine.js` 1015, `anvil.yaml` 913, `server_code/Cards.py` 534, `server_code/DemoData.py` 515, `server_code/Agents.py` 401, `client_code/Pages/Card/__init__.py` 347, `server_code/Teams.py` 311

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
